cases.name: Lasandra Marie "Sandy" Turpin
cases.about: Reported in error on as "Lysandra" and 27 years-old
cases.caseStatus: COLD CASE SOLVED; SUSPECT DECEASED WHEN ID'D
cases.narrative: In 2/2010, Humboldt County Sheriff’s deputies found Turpin’s remains, just 14 teeth, some bone fragments and a few articles of burnt clothing after Ernest Samuel Christie III, who was 16 at the time, told authorities that his now-dead father, Ernest Samuel Christie Jr., made him help dump Turpin's body in a ditch near their home in Fieldbrook, CA, about 80 miles south of the Oregon border in 1988. Christie said his father forced him to help cover the body with tires, douse it in gasoline and set it on fire. He said his dad had held and abused Turpin at his house for several weeks before killing her.
